review.brief: Review the diff of ff781c4 (wave 1) against this change's design.md, not the whole module. Validate: (1) D2's rewrite of buildExternalChargesPage is exactly one ownedVehicles read and the refs reuse is correct, including that ok is genuinely guaranteed at the suggestion block; (2) D1/RD7 is honoured - handlers.go's three call sites are UNCHANGED, and flag any attempt to 'fix' them toward the roadmap text as wrong; (3) D3/D4 fake signatures match the real analytics.Reader and analytics.Recalculator interfaces, and the one deleted assertion lost no coverage the surviving teslaID/start/end assertions do not already carry; (4) the leader-accepted unplanned fix to fakeRecalculator.Reconcile (decision D-A1) is correct and in scope; (5) module-boundary compliance - no HTML outside the gateway, no cross-module DB read, no internal/telemetry import; (6) every doc-pack convention, especially the code-comment rule: NO comment may cite design.md, a decision ID, a change or roadmap ID, or a tier number. The leader already removed one such comment; look for others this change introduced or left in the files it touched. (7) bilingual i18n - this change adds no new user-facing string; confirm that. (8) the delta spec in specs/gateway/spec.md renames the port in all five spots and changes nothing else. (9) anti-gaming: no acceptance criterion was weakened, no task was self-approved, tasks.md checkboxes match what the diff actually does. Performance-Profile compliance matters here: the whole point of D2 is removing a duplicate read on a page render, and D1 is refusing to ADD two more. Judge both against that.
